fields.description: Replaces the ERPNext and Frappe logos in the desk: the desktop's top bar, the loading screen, the app switcher and the sign-in page. A wide logo about 240 × 64 px works best. Upload it as a public file.

fields.description: Off: only ERPNext's and Frappe's own logos are replaced. On: every app in the app switcher shows it.
fields.label: Use the Navigation Logo for Every App

fields.description: At the top of the navigation pane, in place of each workspace's own icon. It uses the Browser Icon, which is square, or the Navigation Logo if there's no browser icon.
fields.label: Show the Logo in the Navigation Pane

fields.description: The small icon on the browser tab, also shown at the top of the navigation pane. A square PNG or SVG, 64 × 64 px or larger. Upload it as a public file.
fields.label: Browser Icon (Favicon)

fields.description: Optional. Shown on the browser tab, and in place of "ERPNext" under the app name at the top of the sidebar.
fields.label: Product Name

fields.description: Light mode only: dark mode keeps its own colors.

fields.description: The greeting banner and each module's header. White text goes on it, so keep it dark. Leave blank to use the sidebar color.
fields.label: Header

fields.description: Links, the blue figures, and what is due soon.

fields.description: What is late, owed past its due date, or below zero.

fields.description: A greeting, the day's figures, what waits for each user, what needs attention in the business, and the modules down the left, on the desk with Frappe's own tiles. Off: the desk as Frappe draws it.
fields.label: Show the Home Dashboard on the Desk

fields.description: Each module opens under a header with its picture, its menu's groups, what needs attention and what waits for the user in it, and a button to make the document most made there, over ERPNext's own cards. Off: Frappe's own module pages.
fields.label: Give Each Module the Home's Look

fields.options:
Whose figures. Each user's home follows what their roles are about: accounts users see sales, what is owed both ways and the cash; sales users their orders and quotations; purchase users what is on its way; stock users the stock value and what to reorder; manufacturing, projects and support their own. Someone with several roles gets them all, the money first. Every figure counts only what that user may read, so User Permissions narrow it as they narrow the lists.

The company. Money is the user's default company's, in its currency.

Fresh enough. The figures are kept for five minutes. Refresh on the home reads them again.

fields.description: Untick a module to take its tile off everyone's desktop. An App or a Folder is a group: its tile holds the modules listed under it, and if you untick the group, those modules show on the desktop on their own unless you untick them too. This changes what shows, not who may open it: use roles and Module Profiles for access.
